Commentary.Commentary: We are set for Pakistan's reply! The West Indian players make their way out to the middle. Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan walk out to bat for Pakistan. Ravi Rampaul will start with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now the target is not a big one and Pakistan will back themselves to chase it down especially when you can use all your batters. Windies, on the other hand, need to bowl well if they want to defend this. If they do manage to do so, it is going to be a big confidence booster for them and if Pakistan do not chase it down, it could well be morale deflating. Join us for the second essay in a bit.

Pakistan can be really pleased with how they bowled. 6 bowlers got to roll their arms over and when you have restricted the opposition to below 140, most of them would have had done a good job. However, they will still not be pleased with the last over by Haris Rauf. We have seen him go for a few lately at the death and it was the same case here. Overall though, they will be quite pleased.

20 from the last over and that would give West Indies some much-needed momentum. This has been an interesting game so far and Pakistan would be quite happy with their show. Quite a strange batting performance from the Windies. They have treated this game like a practice match and that isn’t wrong, to be honest. All of the top-order batters took their time, they probably wanted to acclimatize to the conditions here. None of the top 4 struck at a strike rate of over 100 and none of them went onto bat long once they got their eye in. Pooran and Hetmyer did provide a little bit of impetus and Pollard managed 20 runs in the last over but despite that, the Windies are well short of a par total.

OUT! BOWLED! Haris Rauf gets his man on the last ball of the innings. A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Pollard looks to heave it across the line but he gets an inside edge onto his off pole. West Indies finish with 130/7.
FOUR! Pollard is having some fun out there! Good-length ball, on middle. Pollard hoicks it towards deep mid-wicket to make it five boundaries in a row!

FOUR! Make it four in a row! Not where Pollard intended though! Length ball, around middle and leg. Kieron Pollard looks to flick but it takes the top edge and the ball flies over short third man. The ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Three in a row for the big man! Length ball, outside off. Pollard smacks it to the left of the long on fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! What a shot! Full ball, around off. Kieron Pollard powers it back past the bowler for another boundary.
FOUR! Good cricket all-round! Rauf hurls a pin-point yorker, around off. Pollard squeezes it out and finds the gap between short third man and backward point for a boundary.
Yorker-length ball, around middle. Hayden Walsh digs it out to long on but Kieron Pollard does not take the single.
Short of a length, around off. Kieron Pollard taps it to point for one.
Wide! Afridi sprays it down leg. Kieron Pollard misses his nudge and the umpire calls it a wide.
Hayden Walsh walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Length ball, outside off. Shimron Hetmyer looks to go over long on but he gets deceived by the change of pace. The ball takes the inner half of the bat and goes straight to Babar Azam at long on who gulps  it down.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Shaheen Afridi

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR BYES! Sloppy from Mohammad Rizwan behind the sticks. Another slower ball, shorter in length, outside off. Shimron Hetmyer misses his heave and Rizwan fails to collect the ball cleanly. The ball goes into the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Nicely done! A slower ball, fuller in length, around middle. Shimron Hetmyer drills it past the bowler for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Kieron Pollard taps it to point for one. West Indies bring up their 100!
Length ball, on leg. Kieron Pollard clips it to deep mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
Good-length ball, around off. Kieron Pollard looks to defend but he gets an inside edge behind the sticks to the keeper.

DROPPED! Slower ball, fuller in length, on leg. Shimron Hetmyer looks to flick but it takes the inner half of the blade and the ball lobs up in the air towards square leg. Mohammad Hafeez runs there to take the catch but he drops it. A single taken.
FOUR! A welcome boundary for West Indies! Full toss, around off. Shimron Hetmyer lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Kieron Pollard walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one departs! A low full toss, darted on the pads. Nicholas Pooran looks to whip it but it goes off the toe end of the bat towards Babar Azam at deep mid-wicket, who takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Hasan Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Slower ball, darted on the pads. Shimron Hetmyer misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls away and they take a leg bye.
Hasan Ali (3-0-15-1) is back on.
Length ball, on off. Shimron Hetmyer hits it straight back at the stumps, at the bowler's end. The ball ricochets off the stumps towards long off and the batters take one.
Back of a length, on off. Nicholas Pooran taps it wide of backward point and collects a run.
Short of a length, around off. Shimron Hetmyer works it to the leg side for a run.
Swing and a miss! Slower ball, shorter in length, around off. Shimron Hetmyer makes room to heave it away but he misses.
Full ball, way outside off. Nicholas Pooran squeezes it out to Shadab Khan at backward point. The batters cross for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran whacks it towards deep square leg. Asif Ali there fumbles and concedes an extra run.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full ball, around leg. Shimron Hetmyer shuffles across and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Wide! Afridi bangs in short, way down leg. Shimron Hetmyer looks to pull but he misses. Wided!
Length ball, on the pads. Shimron Hetmyer whips it to the left of the deep square leg fielder. Haris Rauf runs there and saves a couple of runs for his side.
A full toss, around middle. Nicholas Pooran heaves it to deep mid-wicket for one.
SIX! BANG! There comes the first maximum! Full ball, outside off. Nicholas Pooran smokes it straight back over the bowler's head for a biggie!
Wide! Afridi spills it down leg yet again! Nicholas Pooran misses his flick. Wide called!
Good-length ball, around middle. Shimron Hetmyer clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another yorker down the leg side. Wide called as Shimron Hetmyer misses the flick.
Full ball, down the leg side. Wide called.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Shimron Hetmyer goes for the heave but misses.
Length ball, on middle. Shimron Hetmyer clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Short ball, outside off. Shimron Hetmyer looks to pull but he misses and the ball goes to the keeper. There is a stifled appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Shimron Hetmyer is disappointed and signals that the noise came from his gold chain hitting the helmet and Babar Azam calls him back! That is good sportsmanship by the Pakistani skipper.
Just a single as this is pushed to covers.
Another dot. Shorter ball, outside off. Pooran goes for the pull but the ball sneaks under his bat.
Length ball, on off. Pooran drives it to covers. Dot ball.
Full ball, on leg. Flicked to long on for one.
Length ball, outside off. Pooran drives it to covers.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
Almost chopped on! Short ball, on off. Pooran goes for the pull but gets the inside edge past the stumps.
Short of a length, on off. Flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to long on for one. Pooran is off the mark.
Nicholas Pooran is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Rauf is back with a bang! He serves a length ball, on off. Gayle looks to heave it over the mid-wicket fence but the ball goes through the gate. It goes onto hit the stumps and Gayle takes the walk back to the hut.
Haris Rauf comes back into the attack.
A very full one, on off. Gayle runs it to third man for a single.
Length ball, on the pads. Shimron Hetmyer works it past mid-wicket for one.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to covers for one.
FOUR! There goes Gayle! He gets a short and wide one. Gayle hammers it through covers for a boundary.
On a length, on the pads. Gayle flicks it past deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Short of a length, around leg. Shimron Hetmyer clips it to fine leg for one.
Hasan Ali (1-0-2-1) is back on.
Shorter ball, on off. Pulled to long on for one.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Shimron Hetmyer looks to drive but gets it from the inner half back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on off. Pushed to long off for a single.
Flatter ball, on off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Good fielding in the deep. Shorter ball, outside off. Shimron Hetmyer cuts it away. The man at deep point gets to his right and dives to stop the ball. Two taken!
Flatter ball, outside off. Gayle punches it to long off for one.
Just a single as this is hit down to long on.
Flatter ball, on off. Pushed to the right of the bowler. Wasim dives to stop the ball.
Shimron Hetmyer gets off the mark by carving this to deep cover.
Shorter ball, outside off. Gayle punches it to long off for one.
Shimron Hetmyer walks out to bat.
OUT! TAKEN! Chase goes for a timid score! Tossed up, on leg. He hits it straight to long on. Shaheen Afridi takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Shaheen Afridi b Imad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Pushed to covers.

Drinks break! This has been a good start for Pakistan as they have picked two early wickets. The good thing for the Windies though is that people like Gayle and Chase are getting some important time out in the middle to get back in the groove. Imad Wasim comes back into the attack.
Excellent bowling from Hafeez! Nicely tossed up, around off. Chris Gayle prods to block this one out. Just a single off the over!
Just a tad short, around middle and leg. Chris Gayle tucks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, around off. Chris Gayle punches it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, outside off. Chris Gayle taps it to cover-point.
Flatter ball, coming in with the angle, from middle. Chris Gayle defends it off the front foot.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Roston Chase whips it to deep square leg for a run.
Tossed up, down leg. Chris Gayle gets down on his knee and looks to sweep but he misses and gets hit on the pads.
Flatter and quicker, around leg. Chris Gayle tucks it to short fine leg.
Wide! Khan spills this one down leg. Chris Gayle misses his flick. Wided!
Flatter ball, on leg. Chris Gayle tickles it to short fine leg.
Quicker ball, down leg. Roston Chase flicks it to deep mid-wicket to collect a run.
Flatter ball, turning in sharply, from middle. Roston Chase looks to defend but he misses and gets rapped on the pads.
Fuller ball, around off. Chris Gayle drills it to long off for a run.
Loopy ball, on middle and leg. Roston Chase looks to flick but it takes the leading edge and the ball goes towards cover.
Flatter ball, around middle. Roston Chase blocks it out.
Tossed up, around off. Chris Gayle eases it to long off for an easy single.
Flighted delivery, around off. Chris Gayle prods to block this one.
Loopy ball, around off. Roston Chase looks to flick but he gets a leading edge towards long off for a run.

FOUR! Tossed up, around off. Roston Chase lofts it to the right of the long off fielder. Hasan Ali there, collects the ball but his foot touches the ropes and he signals to the umpire that it is a boundary.
Mohammad Hafeez comes in the attack now.
Floated, around off. Roston Chase works it to square leg and takes a single.
Tossed up, around off. Roston Chase blocks it out.
An appeal for LBW but turned down! Loopy ball, outside off. Roston Chase gets low to scoop it over the keeper but he misses and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up, around middle. Chris Gayle tucks it behind square on the leg side for one.
Flatter ball, around off. Roston Chase eases it to long on off the back foot for a single.
Very full ball, around middle. Chris Gayle digs it out to long off for a run.
Roston Chase walks out to bat now. Also, Shadab Khan comes in the attack.

OUT! TAKEN! Shaheen Afridi has the last laugh and West Indies lose their second wicket! Afridi bangs it into the deck, around leg. Simmons looks to pull but it takes the top edge and the ball goes towards short fine leg. Haris Rauf runs to his left and takes a very good catch. At the end of the Powerplay, West Indies are 30/2.
Commentary.Howout: c Haris Rauf b Shaheen Afridi

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around middle and leg. Lendl Simmons clips it towards square leg.
FOUR! Simmons is on a roll! Afridi serves a full ball, outside off. Simmons frees his arms and drives past cover-point. The ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Punished by Simmons! Afridi bangs it into the deck, down leg. Simmons swivels and hooks it past the short third man fielder for another boundary.
Length ball, angling in from middle. Lendl Simmons blocks it out.
FOUR! Simmons finally gets hold of this one! Length ball, around off. Simmons powers it past mid off for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, on off. Pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Nicely played! On a length, outside off. Gayle drives it through covers for a boundary.
Length ball, around off. Punched to mid off.
On a length, outside off. Left alone.
Play and a miss! Length ball, outside off. Gayle looks to drive but the ball goes past the outside edge.
Shorter ball, outside off. Gayle chops it to covers.
Haris Rauf comes to bowl now.
Shorter ball, on off. Chopped towards covers.
Lendl Simmons backs away to the leg side so Wasim follows with a flatter ball. Blocked out.
Darted on the pads. Turned to square leg.
Flatter ball, on off. Lendl Simmons gets the outside edge to covers.
Tossed up, outside off. Lendl Simmons pushes it past covers for a couple.
Flatter ball, on off. Pushed to covers.
Full ball, outside off. Chris Gayle shoulders arms to this one.

OUT! BOWLED! Hasan Ali strikes and West Indies lose their first wicket! Ali hurls a slower ball, on a length, outside off. Andre Fletcher looks to carve it through covers but it takes the inside edge and the ball crashes onto his off pole. Chris Gayle walks out to bat now.

Leg bye! Huge appeal for LBW but turned down! Good-length ball, jagging back in from off. Lendl Simmons looks to defend but he gets beaten and gets hit high on his pads. The ball rolls away past slip and they take a leg bye!
Length ball, around middle. Andre Fletcher flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Short and wide. Lendl Simmons cuts it to point for a single.
FOUR LEG BYES! Good-length ball, down leg. Lendl Simmons misses the flick. The ball clips his thigh pad and goes into the fine leg fence.
Hasan Ali comes to bowl.
Darted on the pads. Andre Fletcher gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls away.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.
Darted on the pads. Lendl Simmons works it past mid-wicket for one.
Darted on off. Simmons backs away and hits it to cover.
Flatter ball, on middle. Lendl Simmons clips it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, on off. Pushed to covers.
Who will bowl from the other end? Imad Wasim it is.
Length ball, on the pads. Flicked down to fine leg for one.
Full ball, on off. Punched to mid off by Simmons.
Length ball, around off. Andre Fletcher runs it to third man for one.
Short ball, on leg. Andre Fletcher ducks under it.
Length ball, on off. Simmons gets an inside edge on the pads and the ball rolls away to point. A single is taken.
Length ball, down the leg side. Simmons misses the flick. Wide called.
On a length, outside off. Punched to mid off by Simmons.
We are set for the game to begin! The players of Pakistan have made their way out to the middle. Lendl Simmons and Andre Fletcher are the opening batters. Shaheen Afridi will start with the ball.

West Indies - Andre Fletcher, Lendl Simmons, Chris Gayle, Ravi Rampaul, Dwayne Bravo, Kieron Pollard (C), Andre Russell, Roston Chase, Evin Lewis, Hayden Walsh, Nicholas Pooran (WK), Fabian Allen, Shimron Hetmyer, Obed McCoy, Oshane Thomas.

Pakistan - Shoaib Malik, Mohammad Hafeez, Imad Wasim, Sarfaraz Ahmed, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Nawaz, Asif Ali, Fakhar Zaman, Hasan Ali, Shadab Khan, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf, Haider Ali, Mohammad Wasim.
TOSS - We have some news from the middle. West Indies have won the toss and they will bat first!

West Indies, the defending champions, seem to be a top side on paper and they are known to play fearless cricket, especially in this format of the game. This is one side that has a number of match-winners and they certainly know how to play in a mega event like the T20 World Cup. Kieron Pollard and his men would look to regroup before the league stage and it will be interesting to see their approach going into this warm-up game. We can expect a lot of entertainment as West Indies has a power-packed batting lineup that can demolish any bowling unit on their day. Will the men in maroon get a win under their belt in their first warm-up game? We shall find that soon. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.

When it comes to ICC events, Pakistan are always considered to be one of the dark horses of the competition and they pose a serious threat to the opposition. This time around, they are led by Babar Azam and this Pakistan side certainly has a huge amount of experience playing in the UAE. They have a solid and experienced batting lineup that can destroy any bowling unit and the inclusion of Shoaib Malik will give them a big boost. They also have some quality bowlers in their ranks and the men in green would be keen to utilize this game time wisely and get used to playing conditions heading into the Super 12 stage.

Hello and a very warm welcome to this warm-up match between Pakistan and West Indies. Both these teams have tasted success at the T20 World Cup before and they would be eager to get some game-time before heading into the Super 12 stage of the T20 World Cup, 2021.
